title: Canonical point-family comparison and the Q-evaluation counit for the coherent nerve of Kan complexes
statement:
Use the coherent nerve and simplicial category of Kan complexes of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], the right-pinched and internal mapping conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the cosimplicial resolution $Q$, coend $V$, map $p$, and evaluation counit of [lem-coef-pinched-rigidification-resolution]. Work in universes containing all the displayed objects. Put $\mathcal S=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathbf{Kan})$. For Kan complexes $X,Y$, write $T_{X,Y}=\operatorname{Fun}(X,Y)$, $R_{X,Y}=\operatorname{Map}^R_{\mathcal S}(X,Y)$ and $U_{X,Y}=U_{\mathcal S}(X,Y)$, with $j:R_{X,Y}\to U_{X,Y}$ as in [lem-coef-infinity-pinch-comparison]. There is a natural isomorphism
$$R_{X,Y}\cong\operatorname{Sing}_Q T_{X,Y}.$$
It sends a map $J^n\to\mathcal S$ to the induced enriched morphism map $Q^n\to T_{X,Y}$. Under this isomorphism, let $E_{X,Y}:V(R_{X,Y})\to T_{X,Y}$ be the evaluation counit, whose restriction to the summand indexed by $\sigma:J^n\to\mathcal S$ is that induced map. Equivalently, $E_{X,Y}$ is the composite of $\theta_{\mathcal S,X,Y}$ with the enriched adjunction counit $\mathfrak C[N_{\mathrm{hc}}\mathbf{Kan}](X,Y)\to\operatorname{Fun}(X,Y)$, which evaluates an enriched simplex in $\mathbf{Kan}$.

Let $q^n:Q^n\to\Delta^n$ be the cosimplicial maximum map: on a subset $B$ in the subset-poset presentation of a morphism from an initial vertex to the final vertex $n+1$, it is $\max(B\setminus\{n+1\})$; it descends after the initial face is collapsed. The maps $\alpha_{X,Y}:T_{X,Y}\to R_{X,Y}$ defined by $t\mapsto t q^n$ in degree $n$, and $\beta_{X,Y}=j\alpha_{X,Y}:T_{X,Y}\to U_{X,Y}$, are homotopy equivalences. In the ordinary localization of simplicial sets at weak homotopy equivalences,
$$[E_{X,Y}]=[\alpha_{X,Y}]^{-1}[p_{R_{X,Y}}].$$
The comparison $\beta$ respects enriched composition, identities, and precomposition by a point $\eta:*\to X$, up to homotopies on the entire mapping spaces, natural in additional simplicial parameters. In particular this precomposition corresponds to $\operatorname{ev}_\eta:T_{X,Y}\to Y=T_{*,Y}$.

For any small simplicial set $K$, use the degreewise currying isomorphism $U_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal S)}(\Delta_K X,\Delta_K Y)=\operatorname{Fun}(K,U_{X,Y})$. Postcomposition with $\beta_{X,Y}$, together with the right-pinch comparison in the functor category, gives the specified natural equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}^R_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal S)}(\Delta_KX,\Delta_KY)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(K,T_{X,Y}).$$
At $X=*$ this is a choice of the point-family equivalence of [lem-coef-space-point-cocone-criterion]: for an edge cocone with adjoint arrow family $\gamma:K\to U_{*,Y}$, its point map is any simplicial representative of $[\beta_{*,Y}]^{-1}[\gamma]$. These assertions retain all faces and degeneracies, are natural under enriched functors wherever the displayed inputs apply, and are unchanged on passing to a containing universe.
